name: junk-drawer
description: Where useful agent skills end up. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and most other agent harnesses.

plugins.name: crossfire
plugins.description: Turns an idea or draft into a design and plan that holds up: finds the agent CLIs you have (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Qwen, OpenCode, Pi), runs adversarial reviews from different models in turn, revises after each, and hands you the decisions that are yours.

plugins.name: docsmith
plugins.description: Reviews or builds decks, spreadsheets, documents, Markdown, and wiki pages: structure, layout, accessibility, editability, formulas, and charts. Follows your DESIGN.md, brand, or template. Fixes the small things, flags the big ones.

plugins.name: night-shift
plugins.description: Maintains repository architecture or reviews a supplied target through scope-wide discovery rounds. Nested coordinators delegate bounded tasks, reconcile coverage, and synthesize findings across business logic, UI boundaries, shared rules, defects, tooling, and hot paths. Carries evidence and unfinished work between runs.

plugins.name: project-backup
plugins.description: Backs up what Git cannot give back: signing keys, credentials, private config, and local data. Builds a dated, owner-only folder with restore notes and checksums, to keep wherever you like or carry to a new laptop.

plugins.name: unslop
plugins.description: Makes a draft read like a person wrote it: strips chat residue, checks facts and story, cuts the patterns that mark text as machine-written, keeps the writer's voice.

plugins.name: the-whole-drawer
plugins.description: Every skill in the drawer at once.
